requirements.requirement: Identify the former Director General and Minister who lost their life to cancer, and determine the year in which that death occurred.
The company in question was founded in the same year as the death of that former Director General and Minister.
The company fully acquired a platform, and that platform significantly increased the company's global community.
As of 2021, the company had a network reaching over 70 countries.
A few years after the point at which, as of 2021, the company had a network reaching over 70 countries, the company launched its platform to provide operational transparency.
Determine the name of the company.
